name: refactoring
description: Fowler's Refactoring (2nd ed.), Kerievsky's Refactoring to Patterns and the 23 GoF design patterns as two Agent Skills, one per refactoring book: 29 code smells, 66 refactorings, 27 refactorings to patterns and 23 patterns, each with a C# 9 example, plus two subagents: one finds smells and plans, the other applies one refactoring.
